description: This file defines a singleton and a utility class related to managing a PeekabooBridge host and its associated services within a macOS application. It handles socket path management, service setup, and secure system interactions.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the PeekabooBridge host, including starting, stopping, and ensuring legacy socket symlinks.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Encapsulates various services related to PeekabooBridge, including permissions, UI automation, snapshot management, and system interactions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host based on the provided boolean.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current host if running and resets related properties.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host if it's not already running.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures that legacy socket symlinks are created for compatibility.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates or updates a symlink for a legacy socket path.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current security team identifier for code signing.
